description.zh:
查询条件语句。

您可以根据[高级查询的SQL语法](~~2557373~~)编辑查询语句。
description.en:
The conditional statement for the query.

For more information, see [SQL syntax for advanced queries](~~2557373~~).

description.zh: 是否开启简单查询模式。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable simple query mode.

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，为您演示如何将查询条件语句保存为一条高级查询历史记录，该查询语句用于在日志中查询所有`AccessKey`访问事件。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example of how to save a conditional statement as an advanced query record. The statement queries logs for all `AccessKey` access events.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun actiontrail create-advanced-query-history --query-sql event.userIdentity.accessKeyId:_0 --simple-query false --api-version 2020-07-06 --region cn-hangzhou
